meta.title: Al Plan Hotel — Elenia Bozzato
meta.description: Brand direction and coordination for Al Plan Hotel, a family-run hotel in Val Badia: communication, content and coordination of marketing activities.

alplan.heroAlt: Aerial view of Al Plan Hotel in winter, with the gondola and the snowy mountains
alplan.logoAlt: Al Plan Hotel logo, a mountain-moving hotel
context: Al Plan Hotel is a family-run hotel in San Vigilio di Marebbe, in Val Badia. It brings together mountain hospitality and the owners’ passion for collecting, motors and old crafts.

An unconventional place, where themed rooms, historic objects on display in the common areas and the panoramic rooftop pool tell a story of passion, research and personality. With the extension and the move to four stars, the hotel had widened its offer, which made it even more important to communicate what makes it unique.
needs: The growth of the hotel had brought new opportunities, but also more complexity in managing communication.

Although the family worked with agencies specialised in hotels, they needed a trusted person to support them in the daily management of marketing, coordinate the different activities and help make communication more authentic and true to the hotel’s identity.

The goal was to bring out what makes the hotel special through texts, images and messages that convey not only the services on offer, but also the personality of the family and the experience that makes Al Plan Hotel different from the others.
role: I joined the project as a consultant for brand direction and coordination, becoming a point of reference for the family in managing communication.

I work on content and on the different touchpoints with the guest, to make the hotel’s language warmer, more personal and more consistent with its identity. I also support the family in communication choices and in running activities, working together with the agencies that handle the more specialised sides of hotel marketing.
activities: rewriting the room descriptions, to highlight their character with an authentic and distinctive tone of voice
creating the room floor plans for the website
reviewing the texts of the automatic emails along the whole guest journey, from the offer to the booking, the stay and the post-stay
replying to online reviews, positive and negative, with care for tone of voice and for the relationship with the guest
updating and optimising descriptions and images on travel portals
ongoing consulting on communication choices, content and the consistency of materials
coordinating and supporting marketing activities, together with the agencies involved
results: Communication is moving towards a more authentic and personal language, one that better represents the family’s identity and the experience Al Plan Hotel wants to offer its guests.

The different touchpoints with guests are handled with more consistency and care, and the family can rely on a stable point of reference to discuss communication choices and to carry out daily activities with more continuity.
The collaboration also makes it possible to combine strategic and operational support with the specialist skills of the agencies, which leads to more coordinated and sustainable marketing.

testimonial.quote: “Having Elenia by our side lets us handle communication with more calm and organisation. She understood our reality, our story and what makes our hotel special, and helped us tell it in a more authentic way. She is a reliable point of reference, always open to discussion, who supports us with care and a practical mind in our many daily activities. We are very happy with the collaboration.”
testimonial.author: The Trebo family

meta.title: Carrozzeria Bozzato — Elenia Bozzato
meta.description: Brand direction and coordination for Carrozzeria Bozzato: rebranding, visual identity, stationery, website and social media communication for the family business.

context: Carrozzeria Bozzato is the family business founded by my father Ennio in 1984.
Besides body shop services, it specialises in custom conversions for driving and transporting people with disabilities, with a strong focus on quality and care for the service.
needs: As the company evolved, it needed a more consistent visual and communication identity, one able to clearly represent both souls of the brand and its current positioning.
role: In 2019 I developed the rebranding project for the company, starting from the restyling of the logo and the definition of the whole coordinated image, created as part of my thesis.
Since then I have followed the brand on an ongoing basis as the point of reference for communication, looking after the direction and coordination of its identity over time.
activities: design and restyling of the company logo
development of the visual identity system
development of stationery and corporate materials
coordination of visual communication over time
design and graphic development of the company website
ongoing management of social media communication
supporting the definition of the visual identity of the offices
slides: The Carrozzeria Bozzato logo before and after the restyling
Business cards and letterhead in blue and orange with the new mark
Letterhead and company sheets with the mark and the graphic sign as a watermark
Company envelopes in blue, orange and grey with the Carrozzeria Bozzato logo
Two white vans with the blue livery and the new logo
Pages of the brand manual: mark and applications
Calendar with photographs and illustrations of the local area, month by month
The Carrozzeria Bozzato website shown on a laptop
The Carrozzeria Bozzato Instagram profiles on two smartphones
results: The brand has developed a more consistent and recognisable identity, in line with its evolution and its current positioning.
Communication now reflects the reality of the company more faithfully, helping to create a more modern, structured and professional perception.

testimonial.quote: “We started working with Elenia on the communication of our body shop when she was still at university. Over time she has followed the whole evolution of the project closely, growing together with the company and bringing more and more order and consistency to our image. The restyling of the brand was an important step for us: it gave Carrozzeria Bozzato a new identity, clearer and more representative of what we have become over the years. Today communication is more structured and recognisable, and working with Elenia has become a constant presence in the company’s growth. It is work that was born in the family, but that over time has taken on an increasingly solid professional value.”
testimonial.author: Ennio

meta.title: Perform Health — Elenia Bozzato
meta.description: Brand identity design and development for Perform Health, from naming to the visual and communication system, up to the website and corporate materials.

perform.heroAlt: Andrea and Mattia in front of the Perform Health logo
context: Perform Health is a project started by Mattia and Andrea Cordenos, a physiotherapist and an athletic trainer.

The idea was clear from the start: to build a service that brings together physiotherapy, movement, psychology and nutrition, to help people recover from pain, prevent inactivity and improve their physical performance.
The project started from a defined vision, but without a structured communication identity.
needs: The project needed a complete brand identity, from naming to the development of the visual and communication system.
The goal was to turn an already clear vision into an identity that is recognisable, consistent and ready to use on every touchpoint of the brand.
role: I joined the project at the early stage of building the brand, contributing to the development of the naming and to the definition of the visual and communication identity.
I built the brand system from the ground up, also defining the tone of voice and the communication line of the project.
activities: logo and visual identity design
definition of the colour system and graphic language
development of stationery and corporate materials
website design
support for visual and content communication
ongoing support in brand communication
slides: The Perform Health logo in orange and blue, with the payoff “physiotherapy & training”
Perform Health business cards in grey with the orange and blue logo and the figure of a running athlete
Perform Health gift card with the logo and the stylised figure of the athlete
The Perform Health website shown on a laptop, with the title “Activate body and mind”
The Perform Health gym, with yellow training structures and an artificial grass floor
College-style jacket and blue T-shirt with the Perform Health logo, made for staff and clients
results: The brand has gained a clear, recognisable identity, able to express both its highly specialised professional side and the human, welcoming approach of the project.
Perform Health is now seen as a structured place that is close to people, with communication that is consistent with the founding values of the project.

testimonial.quote: “We first turned to Elenia for our company logo, and even before that for choosing the name. An important and essential step in the birth of a project. She gave us several ideas linked to the meaning we wanted to give our company, and in the logo she introduced colours that suited our field of work better. And she did all this with so much commitment and dedication that, in a short time, she developed what sets us apart every day. We can say we are completely satisfied. Our brand was born from this name and this logo. And we are still grateful today for the work she did. For this reason we also relied on her for our website, for the layout of business cards and notepads, for advertising material (posters, window decals, online ads), for clothing for staff and clients, and for the ongoing support she gives us with social content. Working with her continues to be fruitful and rewarding, thanks to the professionalism she always brings. And we will keep working with her on many more projects.”
testimonial.author: Andrea and Mattia

applying the stationery and visual system to promotional materials

meta.title: Paola Nadin, Consu.Lab — Elenia Bozzato
meta.description: Strategic training and consulting for Paola Nadin’s Consu.Lab: visual identity, website and a training path to make social media communication independent.

paola.heroAlt: The Consu.Lab mark in white on a brown background
context: Consulab is the project developed by Paola Nadin, a management consultant, to give her professional activity a more organised and recognisable approach.
The project grew out of her consulting work, with the aim of creating a more structured business, also through a network of professionals who support companies.
needs: The project needed a complete path of strategic and training support, both for defining the visual identity and for building digital communication.
In particular, it needed a website consistent with the new positioning, and social media communication that is independent, orderly and repeatable over time.
role: I stepped in as a strategic and training support, working alongside the client to define the new positioning of the project and to turn her identity into concrete communication tools.
I guided the development of the visual system and of the website, working with the developer and supervising the overall consistency of the project.
At the same time, I designed a training path to make the management of social media communication independent and sustainable over time.
activities: development of the visual identity of the Consulab project
coordination of the graphic system in line with the personal brand
creative direction and supervision of the website development
definition of guidelines for content and digital communication
design of social layouts and graphic content series
training path on social media management and strategy
ongoing support during the operational phase
slides: The Consu.Lab logo by Paola Nadin in brown, with the payoff “One step at a time towards what matters”
Consu.Lab business cards by Paola Nadin, front and back, in white and brown with the mark and a QR code
The Consu.Lab website shown on a laptop, with the photograph of Paola Nadin
The Consu.Lab Instagram profiles on two smartphones, with the post grid in brown and pink tones
results: Consulab now has a clear and consistent identity. Communication has become more structured and independent, which lets the client manage her digital presence on her own.
The project strengthened the perception of professionalism and clarity in how it is positioned towards companies and potential clients.

testimonial.quote: “I relied on Elenia for the consulting service and I was delighted with it. meta.title: About me — Elenia Bozzato
meta.description: I grew up inside a company. That is where I learned what running a business means, and today I see brands as people, stories and ideas.

hero.imgAlt: Elenia Bozzato as a child, with coloured markers

story.title: I grew up inside a <em-acqua>COMPANY</em-acqua>
story.p1:
As a child I spent my afternoons in the office of the family body shop,
between computer games, smiles for customers and drawings scattered on the desk.
story.p2:
I watched my father Ennio build his business day after day
and followed my mother Elisabetta through the company’s daily work.
story.subtitle:
That’s where I learned
what running a BUSINESS really means:
story.tight:
the responsibilities, the difficulties, the decisions to make… but above all the passion
and the vision it takes to build something of your own.
story.p3:
That’s why today I don’t see brands only as projects, but as people, stories and ideas
looking for a clear form, so they can be told in the right way.

split.imgAlt: Elenia Bozzato in a pink suit with a laptop under her arm
split.eyebrow:
I have always lived
between creativity and strategy
split.p1:
I drew as a child, and I still nurture
my artistic side through cyanotype,
glass painting and many small creative projects that
fill my free time.
split.p2:
Alongside my creative sensitivity,
a deeply strategic side grew too:
when I met marketing in my economics
books at school, something clicked.
I realised that communication, aesthetics and vision
could live on the same path,
and that is why I chose to study
communication at university.
split.lead:
Today this balance is still the heart
of my work:
split.closing:
a CREATIVE EYE
that can imagine
and a STRATEGIC MIND
that can give direction.

items.title: FREEDOM
items.text:
I believe in a way of working that is free, fluid and open to ideas, where creativity
and vision can truly express themselves.

items.title: RESPECT
items.text:
Every project starts with listening. That is why I value people, their stories
and what they want to build.

items.title: ETHICS
items.text:
I choose communication that is aware, transparent and true to the real value
of what we talk about.

items.title: TRUST
items.text:
I build sincere, lasting relationships, where you feel guided with clarity
and calm at every stage of the journey.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text:
I believe in brands that have something true
to say. My goal is to help them find
a clear, recognisable and authentic voice, through
communication that creates value.

mission.title: Mission

I create tailor-made communication paths to give
